name: Hermbot
author: ozz1ee
description: Your Hermes Bot Mode roster in the bar: every bot drawn as its own avatar, the newest thing it said, and one click to reach it.

barWidget.description: Bots that are active or waiting on you appear in the bar as their own avatars - the shape and colour they have in Hermes - and the panel lists every bot with its newest message, the session it is in (or the last one it finished), its pinned chats, and one click to open any of them.

schema.label: What sits beside the mark
schema.description: avatars = the bots that are active or waiting on you, drawn as themselves - no number, because the faces are the signal; count = one number: how many want you; none = the mark alone.

schema.label: Panel order
schema.description: attention = bots that want you first, longest wait at the top, then a rule and everyone else by recency; gateway = grouped by what the gateway serves and what it does not; flat = purely by recency. The g key cycles it and the choice is saved.

schema.label: Most avatars to show in the bar
schema.description: How many faces sit beside the mark before the rest are left out; the panel always lists every bot.

schema.label: Notify when a bot writes or waits for you
schema.description: Hermes' own desktop notifications are left to Hermes. This is the watcher raising an Omarchy card when a bot's newest message is not yours, with a click that opens that bot. Only transitions are announced, at most one card per bot.

schema.label: Show pinned chats
schema.description: A PINNED section under the bot list, grouped by the bot each chat belongs to - the same chats Hermes Desktop shows pinned, and each one a click away. The p key flips it and the choice is saved.

schema.label: Which instance to follow
schema.description: auto = Hermes Desktop's own connection: switch the app to another host and the bar shows that host's bots, within a poll. local = always this machine, whatever the app is on. The s key flips it and the choice is saved.
